messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates Java code to GNU C++11 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <cstdio>

double func(double x, double n) {
    return -n * (n * n - 3 * n - 3 * x * x + 9 * x - 4) / (2 * (x - 2) * (x - 1) * x);
}

int main() {
    int x;
    double p;
    scanf("%d %lf", &x, &p);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= x; ++i) {
        if (func(x, i) >= p) {
            ans = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%d", ans);
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
